title: Prana category
description: A product category, stored at data/categories/<id>.json. Categories exist mainly so the alternatives engine can tell what a reasonable substitute is. A biscuit is not a substitute for a cooking oil, however favourable its numbers look.

parent.description: Parent category id. Absent for a top-level category. Cycles are rejected by the validator.

substitutable_with.description: Other categories whose products can reasonably replace this one in the same use. This is the constraint that keeps alternatives sensible, and it is deliberately conservative.

relevant_nutrients.description: The nutrients worth comparing within this category. Sodium matters for a namkeen, sugar matters for a biscuit, and comparing everything on everything produces noise.

typical_basis.description: Whether products in this category are normally compared by weight or by volume.
